stories.title: JudgeAgent as central orchestrator with tools
stories.description: Rewrite JudgeAgent: judge becomes the sole game controller with 6 tools. Game loop becomes a tool-use conversation with the judge.
acceptanceCriteria: JudgeAgent has tools: call_player_to_speak, eliminate_player, announce_night_death, start_vote, check_victory, end_game
Game loop: prompt judge → judge calls tools → execute → return results → judge continues → end_game
Judge drives all game flow (speaking order, phase transitions)
werewolf run completes a full game

stories.title: PlayerAgent simplified + isolated memory
stories.description: PlayerAgent becomes pure text-in/text-out. Each player has isolated conversation history. No shared state between players.
acceptanceCriteria: PlayerAgent accepts simple text prompt, returns text response
Each player maintains isolated messages list (multi-turn context)
Players only know: own role + what judge tells them
Players cannot see other players' private info
